newsitem.title: USA: CBOT says financial futures trading open delayed.
newsitem.headline: CBOT says financial futures trading open delayed.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) said on Monday it has delayed the opening of trading in its financial futures contracts due to telephone problems.
The normal 0720 CDT/1220 GMT opening in contracts such as U.S. Treasury bond and note futures was delayed indefinitely until the CBOT resolves the problem, a spokesman said.
He said the CBOT expected to open "as soon as possible" afterwards.
CBOT officials decided before the normal opening time not to commence trading to reduce confusion, he said.
He did not specify the type of telephone trouble.
